scams.name: Koh Samui Airport Taxi Mafia & Grab Blocking
scams.description: You land at Koh Samui Airport (USM) and open Grab. A driver 25 km away accepts for ฿400 to Bophut — then messages: 'Cannot pick up airport, sorry, taxi mafia.' You end up at the official taxi counter where the same trip is ฿800–฿1,200. One traveler documented the exact experience: 'In the early hours today we had taken a 35 minute grab to BKK airport at a cost of B350. In Samui they want B400 to go to our hotel in Bophut???' The Samui cartel is one of Thailand's most aggressive — community reports describe a 2023 incident where drivers physically blocked the ferry pier demanding a ban on Grab/InDrive entirely.
scams.avoidance: At Samui Airport, walk 500m outside the perimeter (toward the main ring road) before requesting Grab or Bolt — this exits the cartel zone Benchmark Grab fares: USM airport → Chaweng ฿250, → Bophut ฿300, → Lamai ฿400, → Nathon ฿500 Use InDrive as a backup when Grab drivers refuse — slightly fewer drivers but same fare logic From Nathon Pier (ferry arrival), walk 5 min inland before calling a ride-share; pier-parked songthaews quote cartel rates If overcharged at the airport taxi counter, photograph the receipt and report to Tourist Police 1155 — enforcement has improved slightly in 2025
scams.location: Samui Airport (USM), Chaweng, Lamai, Bophut, Nathon Pier

scams.name: Car & Scooter Rental ‘Damage’ Fee Shakedown
scams.description: You rent a car from 'All Way Rent a Car' on Samui for a week. You don't smoke. On return the shop charges you ฿3,000 'smoking fee' and refuses to release your passport deposit. A 2025 named-shop community warning describes exactly this pattern, with a parallel community report documenting a second rental shop running the same scheme. The mechanic is simple: the shop manufactures a violation (smoking, minor scratch, cigarette smell) on return, then holds your passport hostage until you pay a 'fine' that doesn't exist in the rental contract.
scams.avoidance: Rent cars from airport counters of major brands (Budget, Avis, Thrifty) rather than Chaweng/Lamai storefronts For scooters, offer cash deposit (฿3,000–฿5,000) + photocopy only — Cat Motors Samui and Mr Ting Big Bike accept this Photograph every panel of the vehicle (including underside and interior) with timestamps; upload to email/cloud Cross-reference any rental shop name in community reviews before paying — 'All Way Rent a Car' and 'Hakunarent' are both named scam shops If your passport is held and a fake fee demanded, call Tourist Police 1155 — the threat alone usually resolves it
scams.location: Chaweng rental shops, Lamai main road, Bophut, Samui Airport rental counters

scams.name: NCK Travel & ‘Funny Day Tours’ Fake Tour Booking
scams.description: You book a zipline day tour for ฿1,500 at a Chaweng storefront called NCK Travel. The shop promises hotel pickup at 9 AM. Morning comes — no pickup. You walk back to the shop: closed, different sign, phone disconnected. One traveler wrote about this exact operator: 'Do not book with this uncle. Booked a zipline trip and promised to pick up at hotel. Try to reschedule at his own time and refuse to…' A parallel community report documents a named snorkel operator (Funny Day Tours) that delivered a 20-minute stop at a fish-free reef instead of the advertised full-day excursion.
scams.avoidance: Book all tours (Ang Thong, zipline, snorkel, Phangan ferries) on 12go.asia, Klook, or GetYourGuide If booking locally, demand the actual operator's name (not the booth's) and verify on their official website Use Seatran Discovery or 100 Degrees East for Ang Thong Marine Park — known legitimate operators Pay by credit card always — chargebacks resolve fly-by-night operator disputes in 2–4 weeks Cross-reference booth names in community reviews before paying — 'NCK Travel' and 'Funny Day Tours' are both flagged
scams.location: Chaweng tour booking booths, Lamai beach booths, hotel lobby tour desks

scams.name: Chaweng Bar ‘Lady Drink’ & Ladyboy Charity Tout
scams.description: You sit down at a bar on Chaweng's Soi Green Mango. A hostess sits next to you within 90 seconds. She orders a ฿180 'lady drink' and the bill escalates from there. Travelers describe this pattern: 'Lady drinks, bar fine, and the price you negotiate with her can easily be 3000+ per night. More for more ladies.' Community reports warn specifically: 'I think there are only two gogos on the island, and they're both on Soi Green Mango… though one is insanely overpriced.'
scams.avoidance: Pay for each drink individually at the bar — never run a tab, never let a hostess order 'for the table' Set a ฿2,000 cash limit before going out; leave cards at the hotel Decline all 'charity' donation books — legitimate Thai charities do not solicit bar customers Choose posted-price venues: Ark Bar Chaweng, Green Mango main venue, Beach Republic Lamai If bill is padded, calmly call Tourist Police 1155 — bar folds quickly at police mention
scams.location: Chaweng Beach Road, Soi Green Mango, Lamai Walking Street, Ark Bar area

scams.name: Chaweng Parking ‘Attendant’ Fee & Fake Currency Exchange
scams.description: You park your rental scooter near Chaweng beach and a man in a faded high-vis vest approaches demanding a ฿50–฿100 'parking fee.' There is no official paid parking on Chaweng's main beach — the 'attendants' are freelance opportunists. Community reports flag this pattern. Amount is tiny per incident (฿50–฿200) but the volume is relentless. The parallel pharmacy / mini-mart short-change scam runs identically to Phuket's Patong — cashier substitutes a smaller note during change, returns ฿100 short.
scams.avoidance: Ignore street 'parking attendants' on Chaweng — no such official service exists Exchange money only at SuperRich or bank counters with posted rates and official receipts Count change in front of the vendor; if short, stay in place and point at shelf prices For massages, use hotel spas or venues with posted prices — not beach touts At restaurants, ask to see the Thai-language menu; prices should match the English one
scams.location: Chaweng Beach Road, Central Festival Samui parking, Lamai night market
